specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.8.1 rules remain active. This version only changes the Primary Phone fallback.

specification.description: v2.8.2 overlay: when no valid phone exists in any source, Primary Phone is 8584020500 instead of 9876543210. Catalog rows that still hold 9876543210 are updated to 8584020500 on upload.

changes: PHONE-DEFAULT-002: when no valid phone is found in Comments or in the passenger catalog, Primary Phone is 8584020500 (was 9876543210) (decision 2026-11-16).
New passengers without a phone are stored in the catalog with 8584020500; the value stays locked like any other catalog phone.

CATALOG-PHONE-MIGRATION-001: an uploaded catalog row whose Telephone is the old fallback 9876543210 is changed to 8584020500, because 9876543210 was never a real phone. Real phones are not touched. The migration is idempotent.
Secondary Phone is unchanged (empty when there is no second valid phone).
AT-08, AT-23 and AT-24 now expect 8584020500. Added acceptance tests AT-63 and AT-64.

Primary Phone.default_applies_when: No valid phone in Comments and, for passengers in the catalog, no valid catalog Telephone.

new_passenger.phone_default: 8584020500 is stored when no valid phone is found; it is not replaced later (PHONE-DEFAULT-002, v2.8.2).

phone_migration.action: On upload, a catalog Telephone equal to a legacy value (digits only) is replaced by the current Primary Phone default, 8584020500. The updated catalog file keeps the new value.
phone_migration.not_applied_to: Real phones, including any other value repeated by several passengers.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: New passenger in two rows of the same file, phone only in the second row
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Both rows use the values of the first row (8584020500); one catalog row

acceptance_tests_patch.case: No valid phone in Comments; new passenger and passenger already in the catalog with a real phone
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: New passenger: Primary Phone 8584020500 and catalog Telephone 8584020500; catalog passenger keeps its catalog phone; 9876543210 appears nowhere
Output Primary Phone and updated catalog Telephone are 8584020500; other catalog phones unchanged; catalogPhonesMigrated counts the row; uploading the result again changes nothing

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-64 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0 to v2.8.2
consistency_contract_patch.phone_fallback: 9876543210 never appears in the Output or in the updated catalog.
